sourceSnapshot: OpenStreetMap / Geofabrik New York + New Jersey 2026-11-20

imagery.attribution: USDA Farm Service Agency / NAIP 2022; local RGB derivatives

architecture.heightInference: OSM height/floors first; missing values use stable neighbourhood/footprint/type estimates. Source high-rise heights retained up to 650 m, never capped to a house template. Not surveyed heights.

modelNotes: Source footprint/contact geometry is retained. Repeated houses use shared estimated architectural templates, other ordinary buildings use shared mid-distance boxes and source-derived district proxies in the far distance. Heights/colours are source fields or deterministic estimates, not guaranteed surveys.
imagery: USDA NAIP 2022 RGB, native 0.6 m; 1.2/2.4 m working pixels
selection: all eligible source buildings across the full 60 km terrain, including multipolygons/courtyards; airport, water and road exclusions; no sparse cell sampling
colourMethod: Footprint-weighted 1.2/2.4 m NAIP working RGB from native 0.6 m imagery, including courtyard exclusion and blue/red panel preservation; estimated regional facades
